projects.title: GDSC CRCE Website
projects.description: Dynamic, responsive website for Google Developer Student Clubs at Fr. CRCE featuring events and community highlights.
projects.longDescription: Developed and maintained the official GDSC CRCE website featuring event highlights, project showcases, and member profiles. The site integrates animations, reusable components, and modern design principles using Next.js, Framer Motion, and Tailwind CSS. It serves as a central hub for student developers to engage with Google technologies and community events.
projects.problem: The club needed a centralized, interactive website to showcase activities and engage new members.
projects.approach: Built a scalable, aesthetic website emphasizing accessibility and smooth user interaction.
projects.results: Increased engagement by 60% and boosted event signups through real-time updates.

projects.title: Legal Assistant AI
projects.description: An AI-powered system designed to support legal professionals and individuals with research, drafting, and insights.
projects.longDescription: A Legal AI Assistant is an artificial intelligence system designed to support legal professionals and individuals by automating routine legal tasks and providing accurate, context-aware legal insights. It assists with legal research, document drafting and review, contract analysis, compliance checks, and case law summarization, improving efficiency, reducing errors, and enabling faster, more informed legal decision-making.
projects.problem: Legal professionals spend excessive time on routine documentation and research tasks.
projects.approach: Implemented advanced NLP models to automate drafting and summarize complex legal precedents.
projects.results: Significantly reduced workload for legal teams while maintaining high accuracy in compliance checks.

projects.title: Kirana Saathi App
projects.description: AI-powered assistant designed to support local kirana store owners by simplifying daily retail operations.
projects.longDescription: Kirana Saathi is an AI-powered assistant designed to support local kirana store owners by simplifying daily operations. It helps with inventory tracking, billing, supplier management, sales insights, and basic financial analysis, enabling small retailers to operate more efficiently, reduce losses, and make smarter business decisions with minimal technical effort.
projects.problem: Small retail owners struggle with manual inventory management and lack of data-driven insights.
projects.approach: Developed an intuitive AI assistant that automates tracking and provides real-time sales analytics.
projects.results: Empowered local retailers to scale efficiently and reduce waste through smart inventory forecasting.

projects.title: Smart Virtual Assistant
projects.description: AI-powered virtual assistant that uses computer vision and NLP to assist users in interpreting scenes and tasks.
projects.longDescription: Developed an AI-powered virtual assistant that uses computer vision and NLP to describe scenes, identify objects, and assist users in daily tasks. Built with TensorFlow and Flask, the assistant processes camera input, recognizes objects, and narrates descriptions using speech synthesis, making it a valuable tool for accessibility and productivity.
projects.problem: Users often need real-time assistance in understanding complex visual scenes or navigating unfamiliar environments.
projects.approach: Combined high-speed computer vision with natural language generation for real-time scene narration.
projects.results: Delivered a highly responsive assistant that improves user independence and situational awareness.
